liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (2 reviews): Describes the opener as a nicely loping version; Starts slowly but takes off after the first verses, running close to sixteen minutes [14][22]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer hears this version reach new heights [22]
- **Picasso Moon** (1 review): Was building toward something good before Brent cut it off early [22]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Finds the Playing in the Band into Eyes of the World transition tight [14]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Remembered as electric [24]
- **I Will Take You Home** (1 review): Hears a unique quality in Brent's performance, full of both sadness and joy [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-06-17.149425.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 186 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1990-06-17.149334.soundboard.ultramatrix.pearson.miller.flac24**: soundboard; 20 songs; 186 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1990-06-17.mtx.hansokolow.97329.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 186 min [3]. Said about its sound: The soundboard has occasional persistent crackle, and a cut in Jack-A-Roe at 1:39 [3]
- **gd1990-06-17.aud.savage-wklitz.96420.flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 196 min [4]
- **gd90-06-17.sbd.ladner.10062.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 178 min; rated 4/5 by 10 [6]. Said about its sound: Says the soundboard sounds pretty good [13]
- **gd90-06-17.nak.ladner.7764.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 182 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [9]. Said about its sound: Calls the recording barely passable for its era but listenable [19]

## Around the show

- Attendee was disappointed that Playing didn't lead into Dark Star, then slept on the lawn until I Need A Miracle [14]
- A Father's Day show on a lazy Sunday afternoon, with the band stretching out and taking its time [19]
- Midland brought his little girl on stage, which the attendee found incredibly sweet [24]
- Mounted police cleared Shakedown Street after Dollar Bill charged parking fees; attendee joined a sit-in with locked arms [24]
- Calls the first eight summer 1990 shows, including Cal Expo, Shoreline and Eugene, underrated next to the strong spring tour [13]
- Rates the Shoreline run as strong, with 6/17 as good as 6/16, which appeared in the View from the Vault series [13]
- Argues 1990 east coast shows matched the west, citing Buffalo, Pittsburgh, RFK's Dark Star and Brent's last run at Tinley Park [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-06-17.149425.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90) [1]. Also: Three sets of masters were combined to make the show complete; This UltraMatrix soundboard release is FLAC at 16 bit, 44.1 kHz [1]
- **gd1990-06-17.149334.soundboard.ultramatrix.pearson.miller.flac24**: taped by Don Pearson; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  March 27, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90) [2]. Also: Three sets of masters were used to make this UltraMatrix soundboard complete [2]
- **gd1990-06-17.mtx.hansokolow.97329.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: matrix of DSBD: shnid=10062 and DAUD: shnid=96420 by hansokolow using ProTools [3]. Also: Hansokolow made this matrix in ProTools; the first set came from Keith Litzenberger's Sennheiser ME-80 DAT master; Second set audience source is a DAT clone from Bill Savage's AKG 414 microphones, transferred by Litzenberger [3]
- **gd1990-06-17.aud.savage-wklitz.96420.flac16**: taped by Bill Savage and Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: 1st Set: Sennheiser ME-80's>Technics SV-MD1; 2nd Set: AKG 414's>?>Technics SV-MD1 [4]. Also: Torrent includes two encore versions: one from the Sennheiser ME-80 recording at the end of the first-set DAT; The other encore comes from the complete AKG 414 recording of the second set [4]
- **gd90-06-17.sbd.ladner.10062.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>DAT>CDR [6]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by www.gdao.org: [T-shirt: "Shoreline Amphitheatre / Grateful Dead" skull. Back: "Shoreline Dead '90" · Grateful Dead Archive Online · Gra](https://www.gdao.org/items/show/276547) [26]
